**Hint 1:** Consider how regularization affects the model parameters. As λ increases, the regularization term becomes more dominant in the loss function. Think about how this might impact the model's ability to fit the training data and how it relates to bias.

**Hint 2:** Recall the bias-variance tradeoff in machine learning. Increasing regularization typically increases bias because the model becomes less flexible. Consider how an exponential regularization function might amplify this effect as λ becomes very large.
